gameDescriptionHtml:
Stealth with a Twist! Eggs-traordinary times call for eggs-traordinary heroes. After surviving the daring events of Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget, the gang is back in a brand-new adventure, and it turns out nuggets weren’t the only thing on the menu – chickenkind is still in danger! Stealth with a Silly Twist – Hide in bins, disguise yourself as a traffic cone, or leg it in a full-blown panic. Whatever works. High-Octane Escapes – Release those chickens and let the chaos ensue. Sure, chickens aren’t meant to fly, but when the alternative is getting caught… we wing it.

Co-op Chaos! Take control of Molly, Rocky, Frizzle and the gang as they sneak, scurry & scramble through five tantalizingly treacherous fortified farms to liberate captured chickens. But don’t count your chicks until they’re hatched – you’ll need to outwit bumbling security, dodge watchful CCTV, and topple an army of loopy poultry villains.

Chaotic Co-op – Team up in two-player co-op to solve puzzles, cause absolute mayhem, and accidentally (or deliberately) ruin your friend’s escape plan. 100% Aardman Fun! 100% Chicken Run – Created at Aardman Animations, expect a brand-new feather-ruffling story packed with the evil villains, unexpected twists, and plenty of clucking good silliness. The stakes are high, the chickens are feisty and the explosions inevitable.

Are you ready?

Game Features

  • Humorous stealth! Hide in trash bins, use traffic cones as disguises, or run like crazy if you get scared! There are no rules – as long as it works.
  • Dizzying escapes! Set all the chickens free – let the great chicken chaos begin! Chickens can’t fly? Nonsense! When they’re being chased, even chickens flap their wings and take off as far as they can!
  • Crazy co-op! Play together, solve puzzles, unleash total chaos, and accidentally (or maybe not so accidentally!) mess up your friends’ escape – it’s up to you!
  • Chickens, assemble! Create your own team of chicken heroes to take on missions! Each chicken has its own personality, unique skills, and awesome gadgets!
  • The real Chicken Run! Created by Aardman Animations! Experience a brand-new thrilling story full of dastardly villains, unexpected twists, and outrageously funny chicken mayhem!
